This service bridge exports all robotkernel-5 services via [[links_and_nodes|links-and-nodes]]. LN-Message definitions are generated dynamically from the robotkernel-5 service defintions.

= Configuration =

 bridges:
 - name: ln
   so_file: libbridge_ln.so
   config:
     loglevel: info

There is no need to supply ln manager settings here. These are parsed from command line arguments ( -ln_manager <host>:<port>).
